case_constraints_checked: No new infrastructure or irreversible change until the bottleneck or failure mode is verified
The recommendation must include verification steps
The report must preserve uncertainty and evidence against the chosen action

checks_run.description: Final report includes all required audit sections.
Every evidence item includes source_type, source_uri, claim, reliability_score, and relevance_score.
Hypotheses do not use novelty_score as a core MVP field.
Evidence against or uncertainty is explicitly listed before recommendation.
Permanent architecture or production changes are not recommended before verification.

contradictions.description: The selected path is plausible, but current evidence is incomplete and must be verified before irreversible action.

mode_specific_checklist: Prefer a reversible diagnostic before a permanent fix
